anchor.statement: Proposition 9.5. Starting with the fixed base and the curls of the primary potentials, perform the temporal mean update (8.20) and the five-equation correction (8.25), reconstructing pressure by (8.12) before and after each update. The resulting fields form a state at stage 0 in the sense of Definition 9.4; in particular, their residual orders are B 0 = 0.7 and C ∗ 0 = 1.2.

correspondence.note: The initialized state (primary curls, then the temporal and five-row mean updates) satisfies CycleAnalyticInvariant at σ = 1/5, i.e. B0 = 1/2 + 1/5 = 0.7 and C0* = 1 + 1/5 = 1.2.

The literal same-choice initialized state satisfies every analytic,
support, regularity, and representation field used by the correction cycle.
